summary: Quanta Services, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a registered public offering of senior notes: $500M 4.850% notes due 2029, $750M 5.300% notes due 2033, and $750M 5.550% notes due 2036. Underwriters include BofA Securities, Wells Fargo, J.P. Morgan, PNC Capital, and Truist. The offering is under an existing S-3 shelf, closing expected August 6, 2026. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation, so no category applies.
